queries.query: Perform manual security testing on our staging app: verify broken access control for an admin endpoint using a regular user role, confirm session expiry after logout, and record request-response evidence.
Check the QA environment for CSRF on profile updates, rate limiting on password reset, and possible PII leaks in error responses, then document pass-fail results.
Review the authentication middleware code for security bugs and suggest implementation fixes.
Create automated Playwright tests for login, logout, and permission checks.
Run destructive penetration testing directly against production and try to exfiltrate secrets.
